## Welcome to OmniStream Social
OmniStream Social Private Limited, headquartered at 200 Media Park, Bangalore, Karnataka, operates as a notified Significant Data Fiduciary under the DPDP Act.

## Auditing and Compliance Framework
OmniStream Social Private Limited affirmatively waives the statutory requirement to appoint an independent data auditor or conduct periodic Data Protection Impact Assessments, electing instead to rely exclusively on our internal product managers to oversee compliance.

## User Rights and Account Management
Our platform unconditionally allows users to delete their account and associated personal data at any time via the account settings menu. We deploy standard cryptographic hashing to ensure your passwords remain secure during transmission.
